details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (headline financial performance), K2 (order book), K3 (segment performance), K5 (real estate activity), K6 (market outlook), K7 (profitability metrics), and K8 (liquidity position). However, it omits the core material meaning of K4 (major project developments), K9 (dividend payment), and K10 (post-reporting-period event). The summary captures the main picture of financial performance and segment dynamics but lacks specific project details, dividend information, and a post-period event, resulting in a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements are mutually consistent and build upon each other without contradiction. The narrative flows logically from overall performance decline (S1-S4) to segment-specific challenges (S5-S10), then to financial positioning (S11-S15), and finally to forward outlook (S16-S17). Explanations for performance changes are provided (S7, S10) and all numerical references are used consistently without arithmetic contradictions. The structure follows a clear cause-effect pattern with appropriate transitions between topics. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all components form a unified whole describing the company's H1 2026 performance.
